iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 59. STABLE: IAEA cannot verify enrichment suspension - 440kg 60% uranium location uncertain. New Isfahan underground site status unknown. JINSA: Fordow expansion could yield several bombs per month. CSIS: stockpiles sufficient for 10 weapons in 3 weeks. Trump says HEU 'deeply buried but under satellite surveillance.' Half of HEU possibly at Isfahan. E3 NPT statement March 2026. IAEA locked out of bombed facilities. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability 37%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 59. BLOCKADE DAY 3: US blockade fully operational - trade halted. Diplomats working back channels for 2nd round talks. Pakistan racing to host. Trump hints talks within 48 hours. IRGC threatens to bomb US warships. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite blockade - direct challenge. Oil Brent ~$94.87 trending toward $100. IEA warns worst energy crisis in history. Ceasefire deadline Apr 22. Diplomatic window OPEN but military standoff deepens. Probability 62%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 59. WASHINGTON TALKS UNDERWAY: Sec Rubio hosting Israeli and Lebanese ambassadors. Hezbollah Qassem rejects direct negotiations as 'futile' and 'treason.' Israel rejects ceasefire, continues strikes - 35 killed past 24h. 350+ killed Apr 8 strikes. 1M+ displaced. Rubio: 'not resolved in 6 hours.' Hezbollah claims 24 attacks on Israel Tuesday. Pope demands ceasefire. Probability 45%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: ESCALATING: Roketsan opens new missile production facilities - 'largest defense investment in Republic history.' TAYFUN Block 4 hypersonic ballistic missile entering serial production 2026. Range exceeds 1,500km. Defense spending up 30% to $27.34B. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned. Pushing for EU defense integration. 1,700 defense companies at SAHA 2026. Warns Israel as 'Hitler of our time.' Probability 14%. Rising.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR 2026 survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely - Tier II risk. Pakistani Defence Minister hostile warnings. 2025 Operation Sindoor precedent. Pakistan also mediating Iran ceasefire. Drivers of conflict intact - terrorism from Pakistan. No new escalations past 24h. Probability 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 63. RISING: Kremlin warns Finland over nuclear weapons hosting - 'will pose threat, force countermeasures.' Finnish parliament vote expected on nuclear policy. Medvedev nuclear threats to Finland/Sweden as 'automatic targets' confirmed. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war vs neighbor in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Carnegie: belligerent post-war posture. Iran war 'strategic windfall' - oil revenues surging billions. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. NPT Review shaping as battleground. Probability 68%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: Taiwan tracking rising Chinese naval activity - 'very rare' increase beyond typical 50-60 ships. Xi met KMT chairwoman Cheng Li-wun - 'absolutely not tolerate' independence. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite US blockade - direct challenge. Wang Yi visited Pyongyang - China-NK rail resumed. PLA Type 055 destroyers live-fire drill. Taiwan launches military drills to secure energy routes. $14B US arms for Taiwan. ISW/AEI updates weekly. Probability 33%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 59. ESCALATING: Kim oversaw 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer Apr 12 - 2 cruise + 3 anti-ship missiles. Third round of destroyer tests in 6 weeks. Kim pledges boost to navy operational capability. 4th destroyer under construction. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Wang Yi visit strengthens China-NK axis. Probability 88%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1160+. SUSTAINED: ISW daily assessments continue. Russia Easter escalation - 110+ drones targeting civilians. Russia warns Europe over drone production for Ukraine - 'unpredictable consequences.' Patriot missile shortage as systems diverted to Iran theater. Russia declares liberation of Luhansk. Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging billions. 1.2M Russian casualties estimated. Probability 82%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: SUSTAINED: China-mediated ceasefire talks resume in Urumqi - 2nd round underway. Fighting worst since Taliban 2021. Temporary Eid ceasefire collapsed, fighting resumed killing 2 civilians. Pakistan operations against TTP continue simultaneously with Iran mediation. Lowy Institute: 'the other war the world is ignoring.' Probability 22%. Stable.
